name: l2cap_credit_queue_flush

ownership.argument: This is the credit-controlled drain the module expects: credits live at stock+14 (stock pointer is channel+4), the queued fragment list hangs off the stock, and sending is the same 0xC7FE4D0 transport call the send handler uses.
